job_name: Reconstructed CLI components and actual seven-image entry
failure: git worktree add --detach source a3c61136 failed with returncode 128: packfile could not be mapped (Cannot allocate memory).

original_log.representation: UTF-8 decoded complete GitHub job-log response; not a reconstruction of the artifact ZIP.

reported_inner_evidence.provenance: CI finish() log reports its own complete readback; this agent has not independently decoded the ZIP.

diagnosis.observed: The common parent applies RLIMIT_AS 1 GiB before invoking git; failure occurred inside that baseline restoration, before CLI-specific code.
diagnosis.inference: Git's documented 64-bit default single packed-object mapping window is 1 GiB and its total mapped-pack budget is effectively unlimited. This is consistent with the observed allocation refusal; the actual process mappings were not captured.
diagnosis.proposed_unexecuted_change: Use explicit small core.packedGitWindowSize/core.packedGitLimit for every Git subprocess, preserving the 1 GiB parent limit, all compiler limits and all test cases.
